# Marga

Marga is a free, mobile-friendly study planner and syllabus tracker for Indian students preparing for board and entrance exams. It helps students track chapters, plan revision, assess preparedness, and understand subject-wise progress.

## Purpose

Marga makes exam preparation more visible and manageable. Students can organise a syllabus by subject and chapter, record revision activity and confidence, and use progress information to decide what to study next.

## Audience

Marga is for Indian school and entrance-exam students, including JEE, NEET, ISC, ICSE, CBSE, KCET and MHT CET aspirants. It also supports custom exam or syllabus organisation.
